authority: Curated programme documentation and provenance index; does not change corpus admissions.
selectionBoundary: Explicit high-level reports, source workbooks, scripts and notes; not a complete numerical environment or transitive dependency archive.

evidenceFamilies.boundary: Raw maps and fit curves are not separate experiments; extraction does not identify all calibration factors.

publicStrengthTestVerdict.reason: Available maps contain spectral features but not the measured correction product required to extract inductive matrix-element ratios. A corrected no-refit comparison cannot be scored.
notInferred: No rejection from raw contrast/area ratios.
No population, transfer or linewidth values invented at unmeasured biases.

pickupVerdict.reason: The paper supplies neither the complete geometry nor the calibration and uncertainty data. The surrogate reveals strong kinetic-drive/self-current rejection and noise requirements, so a 0.5-percent certificate cannot be inferred from a pickup sketch or nominal bandwidth.
